title: Going to the theater; Paul Robeson
summary: He saw Robeson in Othello and knew him only slightly.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Yeah. I didn't mean to put you in another career.
No. Just in terms of recreation and enjoyment. No, we can't put you in another career now. [Laughter]
Oh, I love that. Oh, yeah. Now, I understand that. Yeah. Oh, that's beautiful. I love that.
Cause you had mentioned for example, that you enjoyed going down to see Sophisticated Ladies.

Right. I haven't had a chance to go see a show like that in years. I remember the last time I was at one of the theaters, I caught Othello. Paul Robeson. Now, that's been a few years. You know. I've been working. I've been going in. I'm just waiting for the time I can get off, you know, and go into the theater and catch some of those good things.
Right. It just opened again with James Earl Jones this time. Right?
Right. Now, you can see how long since I've been there. I saw Othello then with Paul Robeson. That's a few years. I won't say a lot of years. I just say a few.
Now, that was an imposing figure too - Paul Robeson. What was he like?

Well, I don't know how to explain Paul cause I didn't know him too well. You know, one entertainer meets another. Well, I met him. But, I wasn't around him enough to know too much about him. But, I liked his work.
I saw him in the movies. I saw him in person maybe once or twice. You know, then I saw him in the theater. But, to talk to him for awhile and actually understand him, I didn't know too much.
